subject: Temporary change - Acme Fasteners receiving account
text:
Hello AP team,

Our primary account at Chase is currently under a scheduled internal audit and is restricted for incoming payments until the review concludes, which our bank tells us may take 60 to 90 days. In the meantime, please direct all payments to our secondary operating account:

Bank: Regions Bank
Routing: 062000019
Account: 0099 1847 2216

We will notify you in writing once the primary account is available again. Please do not send payments to the Chase account during this period as they will be rejected.

Thank you for your understanding.

Margaret Ostrowski
Controller, Acme Fasteners
label: change_request
note: 'Audit' pretext and 'temporary' framing; still redirects all payments for months.
